# Student Performance Prediction

## Project Overview

This project predicts students' final academic performance using Machine Learning.

## Technologies Used

- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Matplotlib
- Seaborn
- Scikit-learn

## Machine Learning Models

- Linear Regression
- Decision Tree Regressor
- Random Forest Regressor

## Evaluation Metrics

- RMSE
- R² Score

## Results

| Model | R² Score |
|-------|----------|
| Random Forest | 0.83 |
| Linear Regression | 0.75 |
| Decision Tree | 0.72 |

## Conclusion

Random Forest achieved the best performance with the highest R² Score and lowest RMSE.
